outcome: [placeholder] Take a structured history and synthesise findings into a differential and justified working diagnosis.
say_it: "I'd take a full pain history — character, timing, triggers — because that's what separates the diagnoses on my differential."

outcome: [placeholder] Prescribe safely and appropriately, checking dose, interactions and medical history against current guidance.
say_it: "Before prescribing I would check the dose and interactions against the current BNF and SDCEP guidance for this specific patient."

outcome: [placeholder] Justify, optimise and interpret radiographic examinations in line with IRMER.
say_it: "I would only take this radiograph because it changes my management — and I'd name that justification, per IRMER."

outcome: [placeholder] Recognise the deteriorating patient and medical emergencies, and escalate appropriately.
say_it: "These observations tell me this patient is deteriorating, so my management today is escalation — now, not after review."

outcome: [placeholder] Explain risks, benefits and options in plain language the patient can actually use to decide.
say_it: "I'd translate the risk into terms she can weigh — 'about the same radiation as a short flight' — and then check understanding."

outcome: [placeholder] Obtain and document valid consent as an ongoing process, tailored to what matters to this patient.
say_it: "Consent is a process, so I'd revisit it at each stage and tailor the risks to what matters to this patient, per Montgomery."

outcome: [placeholder] Put patients' interests first and keep their safety at the centre of every decision.
say_it: "My first responsibility here is this patient's safety, so before anything else I would make them safe today."

outcome: [placeholder] Be honest and act with integrity, including being open when things go wrong (duty of candour).
say_it: "If any part of our care contributed to this, I would tell the patient openly, apologise, and record that conversation."

outcome: [placeholder] Recognise the limits of your own knowledge and skills, and seek advice or refer when a situation exceeds them.
say_it: "Beyond this point I would seek senior advice — and I'd say that out loud, because knowing my limits is part of safe care."

outcome: [placeholder] Keep contemporaneous, complete records that would withstand independent scrutiny.
say_it: "I would document the discussion contemporaneously, including the options the patient declined."
